newsitem.title: CHINA: China urges curbs on illegal insurance fees.
newsitem.headline: China urges curbs on illegal insurance fees.

text.p: The People's Bank of China and the State Planning Commission have issued an urgent notice to curb widespread collection of illegal insurance fees, the Shanghai Securities News said on Monday.

Some insurance firms, in collaboration with local government departments, forced residents to buy insurance which they did not want when they booked railway or air tickets or paid water, gas or electricity bills, the newspaper quoted the notice as saying.
The notice said such charges "violated citizens' interests and must be resolutely checked".
"Any work-unit or individual must not force anyone else to buy insurance," it said.
It said violators would be punished but gave no further details.
